summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting that its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders convened on May 7, 2026, but lacked a quorum and was adjourned. The meeting will reconvene on July 9, 2026, to vote on proposals from the March 27, 2026 proxy statement. The record date remains March 24, 2026, and proxy solicitation continues. This is a routine procedural adjournment due to insufficient quorum, not a special situation event. No deal terms, activist activity, or strategic changes are indicated. The filing is a standard current report of an adjourned meeting.
